title: Visuality++
description: Stunning Visuals, at a low performance cost.
body:
Visuality++ is a Fabric-based Minecraft modpack focused on making the game look, feel, and run better without changing vanilla gameplay. It combines stunning shaders, immersive visual effects, smoother animations, and powerful optimization mods to create a cleaner and more cinematic Minecraft experience.

With support for shaders like Complementary Reimagined, Bliss, and I Like Vanilla, plus packs such as Fresh Animations and multiple vanilla-enhancing resource packs, the world feels more alive while still keeping the classic Minecraft style.

The pack also includes performance mods like Sodium, Lithium, and FerriteCore to improve FPS and reduce lag, along with quality-of-life features like proximity voice chat, dark mode UI, chat heads, and Litematica support.

Perfect for players who want Minecraft to feel modern, immersive, and optimized while staying true to vanilla gameplay.
